item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable with only minor resolver wording cleanup needed to remove avoidable ambiguity around the exact registered query body.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The resolution rule paraphrases the registered query but writes program_numbers as [95.001], which can read as a numeric value rather than the exact string in sourceBinding.transform.programNumbers.","actionRequested":"Change the resolver wording to quote Assistance Listing \"95.001\" and, if possible, mirror the registered transform field names byte-for-byte: programNumbers [\"95.001\"], awardTypeCodes [\"02\"...\"11\"], group fiscal_year, spendingLevel transactions."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Mention that the time-series residual-quantile candidate gave a narrower upper p90 than the chosen widened interval, so the manual widening is deliberate rather than a transcription mismatch.","Keep the FY2026 live-query value framed only as non-comparable pre-window evidence, as the draft already does."]}
